description: The line plot illustrates the performance of three different methods with respect to temperature. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick labels ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5, though the plotted data extends above this range to approximately 85.5. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at its lowest point of approximately 63.5 at x=0.1, rises sharply to 70.5 at x=0.2, fluctuates with a notable drop to 70.5 at x=0.7, reaches a peak of 79.0 at x=0.8, and ends at 78.5 at x=1.0. The "LUFFY" method is shown as a solid red line with star markers, starting at 76.0 at x=0.1, experiencing a minor dip to 77.2 at x=0.3, and generally trending upward to end at its highest point of approximately 85.5 at x=1.0, with a brief decline to 82.5 at x=0.9. The "SFT" method is depicted by a solid teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at 76.0 at x=0.1, remains relatively steady before dropping sharply to its lowest point of 72.2 at x=0.5, spikes to 79.0 at x=0.6, and fluctuates before ending at its peak of 79.5 at x=1.0.
